footnote: Source: National Bureau of Statistics of China (Feb 2026), China NEA (Jan, Feb 2026). Grid connected
notes: China ended 2025 with 3891 GW of generating capacity, up 16.1%. Solar reached 1202 GW (up 35.4%) and wind 640 GW (up 22.9%), together 1842 GW or 47.3% of the total, about 300 GW more than thermal at 1539 GW. Annual wind and solar additions have risen four years running: 120 GW in 2022, 290 GW in 2023, 360 GW in 2024 and 430 GW in 2025. Estimates of China's 2025 solar additions vary widely: the official grid-connected AC figure is about 315 to 317 GW, while DC or installed-basis estimates from other bodies run from 370 to 415 GW. This page uses official figures only.
